rules.message: navigator.modelContext is the old entry point. The draft moved it to Document on 2026-05-27, and Chromium removed it on 2026-07-09.
rules.fix: Use document.modelContext after a check of window.isSecureContext. Do not keep a fallback to navigator.

rules.message: provideContext, clearContext, unregisterTool, and requestUserInteraction are not in the current WebMCP draft.
rules.fix: Call registerTool once for each tool with { signal }, and abort the signal to remove it. Confirm a consequential action with a human step in the page (WMCP-04).

rules.message: registerTool returns a Promise. Without await, a try does not catch NotAllowedError or a schema error, and the failure is silent.
rules.fix: await modelContext.registerTool(tool, { signal }) inside a try, and handle the error.

rules.message: inputSchema as a JSON string. Chrome rejects it, and the tool does not register.
rules.fix: Pass the schema as a JavaScript object: inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: { ... } }.

rules.message: @mcp-b/webmcp-polyfill is deprecated. Its own text says: use @w3c/webmcp-polyfill.
rules.fix: Remove the polyfill (WMCP-02 default), or use @w3c/webmcp-polyfill when the human wants agents in browsers without WebMCP.

rules.message: Hidden character (zero-width, bidi control, or Unicode tag). In a tool name, description, or schema, it changes what the agent reads and passes a review.
rules.fix: Remove the character. Keep tool text plain ASCII or visible Unicode.
